english:
Scoring the required Precision Hits within 3 seconds, or 4 seconds for Bows, with a Sniper Rifle, or with a Scout Rifle while below 2 Armor Charges, grants an Armor Charge.

Precision Hits required:
• Bows: 3
• Snipers: 2
• Scouts: 5

source.text:
Upon scoring multiple Precision Hits within 3 [4 Bow] seconds of each with Sniper Rifles, or Scout Rifles while at <2 Armor Charges:

Grants an Armor Charge.

Precision Hit Requirement:
Scouts = 5 | Bows = 3 | Snipers = 2
